app.title: AI object recognition application
app.guideText: Upload a video, and the AI will find the clips containing a paperclip or a tape roll.

upload.title: Upload Video
upload.description: Select or drag and drop a video file to analyze
upload.dropHere: Drop your video here or click to browse
upload.supportedFormats: Supports MP4, MOV, AVI and other video formats

errors.invalidFile: Please select a valid video file
errors.analysisFailed: Failed to analyze video. Please try again.

video.browserNotSupported: Your browser does not support the video tag.

prompts.start: Extract from the video all scenes that match the description:
prompts.end: Respond only with the start and end times of each scene in the format: minutes:seconds-minutes:seconds. List multiple time ranges if there are several matching scenes. For example: 0:30-0:33, 1:15-1:18, 2:45-2:50.
